fields.body: Shown only to readers in the states you pick, on the pages they use every week.

rateCard._: THE ONE DEFINITION OF WHAT A PLACEMENT COSTS. These prices are published in three places: sponsor.html (the pitch), about.html, and now each sponsor's own portal. scripts/test_rate_card.py fails if a price here is not present on sponsor.html, so the two cannot drift without somebody being told. Prices are MONTHLY since 2026-10-07 (price_month). Change a price HERE first, then the prose around it.
rateCard.trial: First month free on every tier. No card, no commitment.
rateCard.terms: Month-to-month. No minimum, cancel any time, no penalty.

tiers.name: Sponsor
tiers.placement: In every daily briefing, web and email, plus a sponsor strip above the fold on the homepage.
tiers.note: One ag company per issue. Rate locked for 12 months from start date. Once filled, the next slot opens only on renewal.

tiers.name: Own a page
tiers.placement: One sponsor ribbon on a single high-traffic page, category-exclusive.
tiers.note: Any one page: cash bids, the hail map, break-even, a state hail page. The 51 state hail pages can each carry their own ribbon at the same rate.

tiers.name: Supporter
tiers.placement: Your name or logo in the shared Supporters strip in the footer of every page.
tiers.note: Non-exclusive and capped at 6 so the strip keeps its value.
